gen-gf-unkempt-gf-noticia-text: Dignified, yet Unkempt shouts first with a marker-roughened swagger. Noticia Text follows in a literary voice, its lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and each curve entered with a visible, generous lead-in.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-suwannaphum: Unkempt writes like a marker nib that ignores direction. Suwannaphum answers in editorial tones, its tall, squared-off lowercase standing firm where the heading wanders freely, so one scrawls and the other holds the line.
gen-gf-vampiro-one-fs-paquito: Vampiro One sets its midline high and spaces letters out like a stretched spring, with a faint watercolor shift in line weight. Paquito is confident and close-set, best for a light touch.
gen-gf-vibes-fs-karma: Distinctive from the first word, Vibes huddles its lowercase up against the caps with no hairline shift at all. And Karma brings trustworthy, middling contrast, with terminals that finish well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-kiwi-maru: Bold and stencil-sharp, Wallpoet lets its lowercase climb high with paper showing between the letters. And Kiwi Maru lets a longer passage drift along gently, its generous letterspace and far-stopping terminals giving a traditional, editorial pace.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Commanding in manner, Wallpoet rises tall and lean, while Padyakke Expanded One sprawls wide with round bowls of constant wall. And if the heading shrank or the body grew, that wide, slack spacing would quickly take over.
gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-hind: Relaxed and a little crooked, Walter Turncoat writes with tubular strokes, like bent copper pipe. Hind follows with its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, a straightforward, drawn-string steadiness that suits brief copy better than long runs.
gen-gf-walter-turncoat-fs-hoover: Refined meets relaxed here: Walter Turncoat writes with stout, tubular strokes, every diagonal as sturdy as an upright. And Hoover counters with a generous e and compressed ascenders, made for brief spells of reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-hepta-slab: Warnes stretches out, ink strokes tapering before they touch. Hepta Slab lets a longer passage breathe, its open counters and spacious, bookish word shapes giving a dignified, unhurried pace beneath the heading's high lowercase.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-kiwi-maru: Expressive and wide-spaced, Warnes tapers its ink strokes before they touch. Kiwi Maru carries a longer passage in a traditional, editorial rhythm, its terminals stopping far from the stem and its round o keeping a constant wall.
